counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Kingdom of Kebbi (and the Kebbawa of Argungu)

problems: WebFetch returns a model-written extract of each page, not its raw text; quotation marks in the dossiers are the extract's own, and sentences the extract gave without quotes are paraphrased. Some pages were re-queried (Songhai Empire and Sokoto Caliphate three times each) to get dated sentences; each counts as one page.

Overlap with the mali-empire dossier: songhai-empire withdraws Diafunu from Cliopatria's 1475-1500 shape (the page dates the capture to 1501, 1502 in mali-empire) but mali-empire's own 1475 shape also lacks it; a gap-filler should hold Diafunu in Mali until 1501.

Cliopatria's Bamana row ends 1821 and relabels its 1803 outline as Massina 1822-1860, yet Ségou stood until 10 March 1861; bamana-empire adds a 100 km Ségou remnant for 1818-1861 and massina-empire cuts it from its shapes. Cliopatria's Massina 1820-21 shape is mostly the Ségou country.
Cliopatria's Sokoto outline (479k km2) and Wadai outline (260-280k km2) are drawn whole from their first year; both are staged here by dated pages with confidence-1 bridges for the rest.
songhai-empire ends 1599 (infobox) not 1591 (Tondibi) or 1608 (Cliopatria); its remnant needs a dendi-kingdom dossier; Cliopatria's 1595-1608 Songhai shapes are specks and marked wrong.

sultanate-of-darfur runs to 1916 with an 1875-1897 interval of lost land (khedivate-of-egypt then mahdist-state); Cliopatria stops at 1876 and has no 1898-1916 shape. The Mahdist conquest is 1885 on the Darfur page and 1883 in the mahdist-state dossier.

oyo-empire (af-04) should carry the losses of Ilorin (1824) and Oyo-Ile (1836) that sokoto-caliphate records as gains; empire-of-kanem already carries the Bornu counterpart events; saadi-sultanate carries the 1591-92 gains mirrored by songhai-empire.
Counterpart slugs used before their dossiers exist (validator warnings): dendi-kingdom, tukulor-empire, pashalik-of-timbuktu, tunjur-kingdom, bagirmi-sultanate.
